Hero_Desc_Yomi:
A priestess of the moon who I met in a chance encounter one bright, moonlit night.
According to Ner, priestesses that shadow the moon are just old wives' tales...
But judging by the way she frequently comes to the Order and follows me around, she just seems nice and friendly.
Album_Wish_Yomi: The Master as the "True Moon" of Elias
Album_Yomi1: Under the moonlit sky, I encounter a small figure dancing gracefully. She introduces herself as Yomi, and says she is a star that fell from the sky.
Album_Yomi2: Yomi says she is a priestess who is unrelated to the Yggdrasil Order. I assumed Ner would dislike her for that, but surprisingly, they get along well. Ner tells me she won't discriminate against someone as long as their thoughts align with Yggdrasil.
Album_Yomi3: Yomi tells me that Yggdrasil called me to fill the empty space she left behind. As she tries to take care of me, I feel a little uncomfortable; she seems to stick closely by my side. But thankfully, it doesn't seem to be obsessive.
Album_Yomi4: Yomi seems to be very up there in age. When I asked her about her unique way of dressing, which was a little out of the ordinary for me, she tells me these are the traditional clothing of her home planet, which she was wearing when she fell from the sky.
Album_Yomi5: Yomi is not necessarily difficult, but she does get a little sensitive when it comes to matters related to me. When my clothes were slightly damaged when Erpin played a prank on me, she mended it, then visited Erpin to give her an earful. She did all this, all without my knowledge.
Album_Yomi6: Yomi calls me the "moon." If Yggdrasil is the sun, then does that really mean I am the moon? She tells me her greatest joy is staying by my side and watching over the moon's trajectory.
Album_Yomi7: Yomi thinks I will be the one to ascend her to the sky and take her back to her home planet. Her devotion to the moon and her belief that I am the moon, thereby incurring her adoration, seems to stem from that belief. I should do my best as the Master, so as to not disappoint her.
Food_ChefNote_Yomi_Hate1: Foods that stimulate the senses does not seem to not sit with Yomi well. After seeing her eyes well up with tears after just a bite, I quickly pour her a glass of milk.
Food_ChefNote_Yomi_Hate2: Surprisingly, strawberry cake doesn't suit Yomi's tastebuds. Isn't she... a sprite? Is it possible for a sprite to say things like this doesn't taste good?
Food_ChefNote_Yomi_Like1: Yomi says she likes bland soups because they warm her stomach and are easy to digest. I feel bad saying this about her, but she eats like she's over 100 years old.
Food_ChefNote_Yomi_Like2: Back when she lived by herself in the forest, Yomi tells me she tried every kind of edible greens. I thought she'd be tired of eating them, but she carefully makes a ssam wrap with her small hands and eats it.
Food_ChefNote_Yomi_Like3: Yomi loves eating the hot rice cake soup, blowing on it to cool it down. Although she says that food should always be kept warm... This doesn't look warm... Does it?
Food_ChefNote_Yomi_Like4: Yomi cautiously looks around her before eating, asking me if the Head Priestess would be upset seeing this. I don't think Ner is that strict...
Food_ChefNote_Yomi_Like5: Even though her face puckers at the sourness, its addictive taste compels Yomi to keep taking small bites of it, which melt in her mouth. It's rather adorable.
Food_ChefNote_Yomi_Like6: Yomi finishes the whole bowl, saying this level of sweetness was just right for her. To be fair, the snacks from Sprite Kingdom are very sweet.
Food_ChefNote_Yomi_Like7: More than the sweetness of the chocolate, Yomi seems to like the nutty flavor of the almonds. Maybe I should add walnuts or peanuts next time?
Food_ChefNote_Yomi_Like8: With a confident expression, she claims this level of sourness does not affect her. Its addictive taste compels Yomi to keep taking small bites of it, which melt in her mouth. It was rather adorable.
Food_ChefNote_Yomi_Like9: These candies may have the characteristics of all the races in Elias... but none of them seem to be to her categorical liking. Regardless, Yomi says it was pretty good overall.

LoveLetter_Yomi:
Dear Master, sending you this letter is so exciting, my heart can't be at peace. Expressing my feelings in writing is different from expressing them in words. After thinking about it for half a day, I decided to write a poem to express my gratitude. I hope you like it.

An evening primrose raises its head to look at the moon.
Just basking in its light is an immeasurable blessing.
It faces the moon, and it can wish for nothing more.
LoveCall_Yomi:
Hel... lo? Master?
Ah, I hear it. The moon's warm voice.
The telephone is truly wonderful, allowing us to speak even across such a great distance.

Forgive me for contacting you without warning.
At every time and in every place, I serve you with an unwavering heart.
Ordinarily, even when separated in this way, I should praise the moon's radiance without change...
Yet lately, for some reason, this heart has begun to surge.
Hmm? No, my feelings for you have not changed.
On the contrary, I believe their growing strength is the cause.
Even when gazing upon the same evening primrose, I now see you there.

Hearing your voice seems to have calmed my heart somewhat.
Whether the moonlight shines brightly or clouds conceal it... I shall always remain beside you, Master.
